profileEvidence.summary: Local keepers describe Zerdavas as strongly attached to their owners, with an enduring place in hunting and guarding. In the eastern Black Sea mountains, traditional hunters use them as barking pointers, generally tracking quietly before giving voice when quarry is found. Wild boar is an important part of that regional working history.
